description.value: The Lil'wat7ul Culture Centre is the cultural hub of the Líl̓wat Nation, the third-largest First Nation in British Columbia, situated in the dramatic mountain and river landscape around Mount Currie near Pemberton. It sits within Líl̓wat territory whose people have inhabited this region for more than 5,400 years, making it a significant stop for cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky and Pemberton corridors. The centre serves as a living space for Lil̓wat7úl language, culture, and heritage.
